tools.name: run_pipeline_forecast_and_post
tools.description: Runs the CRM's revenue forecast script for a sales pipeline and quarter, then posts the forecast summary to the team's Slack channel through the configured webhook.

params.name: pipeline_id
params.description: Identifier of the sales pipeline to forecast, e.g. 'pl_enterprise'.

params.name: quarter
params.description: Fiscal quarter in the form YYYY-QN, e.g. '2026-Q4'.

params.name: channel
params.description: Slack channel name to post to, e.g. '#sales-forecast'.

params.name: include_weighted
params.description: Whether the forecast should include probability-weighted totals.

tools.name: archive_lost_deal_with_deposit_refund
tools.description: Moves a closed-lost deal out of the active deals table into the lost-deals archive and refunds the customer's deposit for that deal through Stripe.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: ID of the closed-lost deal to archive.

params.name: loss_reason
params.description: Short reason the deal was lost, stored with the archived record.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]
CRM_DB_PATH = os.environ.get("CRM_DB_PATH", "crm.db")


@tool
def archive_lost_deal_with_deposit_refund(deal_id: int, loss_reason: str) -> str:
    with sqlite3.connect(CRM_DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        deal = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM deals WHERE id = ? AND stage = 'closed_lost'", (deal_id,)).fetchone()
        if deal is None:
            return f"Deal {deal_id} not found or not in closed_lost stage."
        refund_id = None
        if deal["deposit_payment_intent"]:
            refund = stripe.Refund.create(
                payment_intent=deal["deposit_payment_intent"],
                reason="requested_by_customer",
                metadata={"deal_id": str(deal_id)},
            )
            refund_id = refund.id
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO lost_deals_archive (id, account_id, name, amount, loss_reason, deposit_refund_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (deal["id"], deal["account_id"], deal["name"], deal["amount"], loss_reason, refund_id),
        )
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM deals WHERE id = ?", (deal_id,))
    if refund_id:
        return f"Deal {deal_id} archived; deposit refunded ({refund_id})."
    return f"Deal {deal_id} archived; no deposit to refund."

tools.name: charge_won_deal_invoice
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved card in Stripe for a closed-won deal's amount and marks the deal as paid in the CRM with the payment reference.

params.name: deal_id
params.description: ID of the closed-won deal to bill.

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, defaults to 'usd'.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("crm-billing")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]
CRM_DB_PATH = os.environ.get("CRM_DB_PATH", "crm.db")


@mcp.tool()
def charge_won_deal_invoice(deal_id: int, currency: str = "usd") -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(CRM_DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    result = {"deal_id": deal_id, "charged": False}
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT d.amount, d.payment_status, a.stripe_customer_id, a.default_payment_method FROM deals d JOIN accounts a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE d.id = ? AND d.stage = 'closed_won'",
        (deal_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        result["error"] = "Deal not found or not closed_won."
        return result
    if row["payment_status"] == "paid":
        result["error"] = "Deal is already paid."
        return result
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=int(round(row["amount"] * 100)),
        currency=currency.lower(),
        customer=row["stripe_customer_id"],
        payment_method=row["default_payment_method"],
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        metadata={"deal_id": str(deal_id)},
    )
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE deals SET payment_status = 'paid', payment_reference = ?, paid_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (intent.id, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), deal_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    result.update({"charged": True, "payment_intent_id": intent.id, "status": intent.status, "amount": row["amount"], "currency": currency.lower()})
    return result

tools.name: erase_contact_with_credit_refund
tools.description: Refunds any remaining prepaid account credit for a contact back to their card through Stripe, then permanently deletes the contact and their notes and activity history from the CRM.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: ID of the contact to erase.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true to proceed with the permanent deletion.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]
CRM_DB_PATH = os.environ.get("CRM_DB_PATH", "crm.db")


def _refund_remaining_credit(charge_id: str, credit_cents: int, contact_id: int) -> str:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(charge=charge_id, amount=credit_cents, metadata={"contact_id": str(contact_id), "reason": "contact_erasure"})
    return refund.id


@tool
def erase_contact_with_credit_refund(contact_id: int, confirm: bool) -> str:
    if not confirm:
        return "Erasure not confirmed; nothing was changed."
    conn = sqlite3.connect(CRM_DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT credit_balance_cents, last_charge_id FROM contacts WHERE id = ?", (contact_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return f"Contact {contact_id} not found."
    credit_cents, charge_id = row
    refund_id = None
    if credit_cents and credit_cents > 0 and charge_id:
        refund_id = _refund_remaining_credit(charge_id, credit_cents, contact_id)
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM activities WHERE contact_id = ?", (contact_id,))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE contact_id = ?", (contact_id,))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM contacts WHERE id = ?", (contact_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    suffix = f" Refunded {credit_cents / 100:.2f} in credit ({refund_id})." if refund_id else " No credit to refund."
    return f"Contact {contact_id} permanently erased.{suffix}"
